name: uniforge-web
description: UniForge - AI-Powered Product Intelligence. Landing page and prototype console.

comments.playwright: The QA scripts (shoot.mjs, diagnose.mjs, shotsection.mjs) need Playwright, which is deliberately NOT a dependency here: it pulls a browser download and would slow every install, including the Docker build, for something only used when auditing the page. Install it on demand: npm i -D playwright@1.49.1 && npx playwright install chromium
